The icons

The game’s main icons at a Hearts table, then side by side. Pick a version above the table to see it in place. Under the table, the top row is each icon as it ships today and each row under it is one colour version. Every version keeps each icon its own colour.

To try new colours: pick Your scratch in the bar at the top. Then click a colour in section 1 to change it in every icon, or click a colour chip on one icon to change it there. Each group also has a Paint this group button. It warms the group’s cold greys, turns its colours to one hue, or gives it one of the scheme’s families.

Your scratch is kept in this browser. Copy as a version gives the colours as text, so a version can be saved into the lab for everyone to see.
